name: proxy-awb
description: Read and update AWB (Agent Work Board) issues through `tclaude proxy awb` when your own sandbox holds no tracker credentials — the `tclaude agentd` daemon calls the operator's AWB server with THEIR account, so you never hold one. Use when you need to find what to work on next (`ready`), read the issue you were spawned against, claim it, read its history or add comments on it, record what you found, close it, decompose it into children, relate it to a blocker, or attach a file to it. Gated on the `proxy.awb.read` / `proxy.awb.write` slugs, neither granted by default, and bounded by an operator allow-list of AWB workspaces, an `awb_workspace` scope on your own grant, or both.

findings.excerpt: tclaude proxy awb ready --compact                  # open, unblocked, unassigned, P0 first
tclaude proxy awb comment list awb-a3f9c1 --compact
tclaude proxy awb create "Add fuzz tests for the parser" --workspace awb \
